name: Thundermane Dragon
oracle_text:
Flying
You may look at the top card of your library any time.
You may cast creature spells with power 4 or greater from the top of your library. If you cast a creature spell this way, it gains haste until end of turn.
blocked_sentences: You may cast creature spells with power 4 or greater from the top of your library. If you cast a creature spell this way, it gains haste until end of turn.

needs.what: a player-wide permission to cast spells from the top of your library at their printed mana cost, narrowed by an affects_spells filter over printed characteristics (here types: [Creature] with power >= 4), plus a rider that gives each spell cast through that permission a keyword (haste) until end of turn on the permanent it becomes
needs.why_existing_wont_do: The static cast_from_library_top is Bolas's Citadel only: the loader refuses it without pay_life_instead, so it always swaps the price to life, and it takes no affects_spells filter (casting.py offers any nonland top card) and has no rider for a keyword granted to the spell cast this way. mana_grant reaches the permanent with haste but only from a mana ability's mana, not from a cast permission; free_cast_permission changes the price, not the zone; grant_playable marks only the cards it sees on resolution and is not a standing permission.
